title: Create Anything
description: A Create datapack for all your needs!
body:
This is a datapack adding a handful of new recipes to the Create mod. This was made in real time on an SMP I ran with my friends, but that doesn't necessarily mean that these are balanced.

**JEI** (**Just Enough Items**) is heavily recommended. Not only for this datapack, but Create in general.

Recipes are as follows:

**Netherrack**

(Mixing) 1 Cinder Flour + 50mB Lava with Heating = Netherrack

![The recipe for Netherrack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0b84eaf86799f72fd25c5b0e72b07f0ca509cb1.png)

**Gunpowder**

(Mixing) 1 Redstone Dust + 1 Charcoal + 1 Copper Ingot with Heating = 1 Gunpowder (10% chance for extra)
Suggested by a friend!

![The recipe for Gunpowder.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6e7a4acb11a63c679ad0577e8c35d3dac50f24e2.png)

**Redstone**

(Mixing) 1 Glowstone Dust/Gunpowder/Cinder Flour/Powdered Obsidian + 1 Redstone Dust = 2 Redstone Dust

![The recipe for Redstone Dust.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3ad3ed534b7c15b90b4c40a2107478378bc4b5c.gif)

**Charcoal -> Coal**
(Haunting) 1 Charcoal = 1 Coal

![The recipe for Charcoal to Coal conversion.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e428456d7444dc5fda2e48cdb4e5b8745c84039f.png)

**Coal -> Diamond**

(Pressing) 1 Coal = 1% (technically 1.1%) 1 Diamond

![The recipe for pressing Coal into a Diamond.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/546cba3358ed6abf583288f96e67e7bd2e3a6be5.png)

**Sand Crushing**

(Crushing Wheels) 1 Sand = 5% Iron Nugget, 2% Gold Nugget, 8% Copper Nugget, 8% Zinc Nugget

![The recipe for crushing Sand.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0eb15d2161792543f6331eded04a05d917514b8f.png)


Uhh have fun I guess, I *might* update this in the future but I don't really know
